description: services.geodata-utrecht.nl: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services.geodata-utrecht.nl. Coverage: the area served by services.geodata-utrecht.nl. The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Signaleringskaart ext. veiligheid transp. en plasbrandaandachtsgebied ; Begaanbaarheid van wegen na bui van 35 mm in 1 uur; Verkeersintensiteiten tbv verkeersmodellen 2023; Carpoolplaatsen - Aantal parkeerplaatsen en voorzieningen 2024. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
